}}'''Naeise''' is a [[Maiden of the Spear]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Naeise|Naeise}}  She is of the [[Moshaine]] [[Sept]] of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].{{ref||Naeise}}

== Activities ==
She, with part of her sept are dispersed through a [[Gateway]] near the [[Plains of Maredo]]. She runs to [[Maeric]] with the news that a huge force of [[Reyn]] are coming towards them. Her clan engages the enemy and she probably doesn't survive the exchange.
